Maya Chen: Quick standup — Phoenix QBR in two weeks. Need final token econ + onboarding status. Major risk: staging tests last week triggered a credits spike. Anyone have 30/90d spend forecasts and a mitigation plan for the onboarding burst?
Jordan Lee: Running numbers now. Short summary: baseline prod usage ~1.2M tokens/mo. Onboarding batch projected to add ~850k tokens over a 3-day window; peak daily ~450k. Net projected month ~2.05M tokens -> est $4.1k at current unit rate. Will attach query + snapshot. :chart_with_upwards_trend:
Jordan Lee: ```-- recent query sample
SELECT date_trunc('day', ts) as day, sum(tokens) as tokens
FROM token_events
WHERE account = 'phoenix' AND ts >= now() - interval '90 days'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1 DESC
LIMIT 90;```
Evelyn Park: Thanks. Two things from enablement: 1) We can gate the heavy test jobs and provide a stepwise plan to ramp concurrency, 2) Recommend turning on prefix/KV caching for the onboarding flows, that should cut replay costs ~30%.
Samir Khan: I can add a soft cap and an automated throttle. Plan: set soft daily cap=350k tokens, with an override for scheduled runs. Also create a routing fallback to the 7B quant model when per-request tokens > 5k. Command I will run: `/apply-cap --account phoenix --soft-cap 350k --override-tag onboarding-window`
OnboardBot: Budget alert: Phoenix has reached 72% of monthly credits (threshold 70%). Next alert at 85%. Details: https://console.redwood/inbox/alerts/phoenix-72
Ravi Patel: Heads-up from the customer: our QA team expects to run a full load test next Thursday morning (UTC). Can we either: (a) temporarily expand credits for that window, or (b) provide a reduced-cost test model?
Jordan Lee: Quick cost options: 1) Temporary credit bump for 24h ~ +$600, 2) Recommend running tests against the 7B quant variant -> estimated 40% lower unit cost. If they need fidelity, we can do a hybrid: 6h on full model + rest on quant.
Evelyn Park: Also capture feedback: QA reported several prompts that generate long outputs (~3-4k tokens) due to verbose error chains. Suggest pass-through truncation in the client or summarize step post-generation. This will materially reduce downstream token consumption.
Samir Khan: I'll create the canary routing rule and the soft cap now, and add a dashboard tile for per-job token spikes. Will also stub a canary policy: if job_label contains "load-test" -> route to quant model unless override flag present.
Jordan Lee: I've attached a quick 90d spend sketch (pasted below):
```
period, est_tokens, est_cost_usd
30d, 2,050,000, 4100
60d, 1,680,000, 3360 (post-caching)
90d, 1,520,000, 3040 (steady state with gating)
```
Maya Chen: Action items:
- Samir: implement soft cap + canary routing (due today)
- Jordan: finalize a cost memo and send to Ravi with the 24h bump option and model-split rec (by EOD)
- Evelyn: create a short enablement doc for QA on truncation + recommended prompts (by tomorrow)
- Ravi: confirm preferred window or if Phoenix wants the credits bump
Ravi Patel: We'll confirm by EOD today. If possible, prefer the model-split option — QA aims for comparable semantics, not perfect parity.
Maya Chen: Perfect. I'll schedule a 20-min prep huddle tomorrow 10:30 PDT to review the memo and finalize the ask for the QBR. Anyone who can't make it DM me and I'll send notes. :calendar: :thumbsup:
